lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
contacts-oca: 888 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 871 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 17 B.
contacts-main: 708 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 674 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 34 B.
contacts-files-action: 691 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 674 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 17 B.
All 4 pages load the same 1 file: 239,983 B raw, 90,083 B gzip, 99.6 % of the smallest page (contacts-admin-settings, 241,005 B).
Inside: @vue/runtime-core 62,474 B, axios 42,235 B, vite-plugin-node-polyfills 29,518 B, @vue/runtime-dom 25,591 B, dompurify 22,985 B.
moment, 354,180 B on the contacts-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 57,429 B on the contacts-files-action page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
lodash, 55,080 B on the contacts-oca page: the full build; lodash-es with named imports ships only what is used.
1,488 B in 2 pieces of 1 file have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (103 packages, 963 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
